{{Top|leg}}
A '''molecular backtrack sniffer''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], and one of the many [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attachments that [[Q9-X2]] modified themselves with. The sniffer was capable of tracking targets by their [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
